description: Join a folder of numbered image frames (frame_0001.png ...) into an MP4, with an optional soundtrack. Use it for a headless-browser capture or any renderer that writes frames. Reports missing frame numbers instead of producing a broken film.

audio.description: Soundtrack file to lay under the frames.

quality.description: draft = fast and small, to check your work; final = full quality.

name: render_frames
title: Render frames to MP4
